notes:
Summary: Harborlane operates D2C retail (apparel + accessories). High seasonal spikes (peak order days) cause ticket volume surges ~5-8x. Primary ask: automated ticket/email summarization + high-precision auto-tagging to drive macros and routing rules in Zendesk. Wants tool-calling to trigger internal macros (order-lookup, refund-initiate) with audit trail. POC data: ~100k historical tickets (3 years), sample 10k for POC. SLA targets: tagging latency <200ms for classification endpoint, end-to-end summarization within 1.2s for agent view, sustainable throughput 120 reqs/sec during spikes with graceful degradation to best-effort classification. Cost sensitivity: moderate - willing to pay for Dedicated capacity if latency and reliability guaranteed.

Recent call notes (raw):
- "If we can cut average handle time by 30% and reduce routing errors we'll have huge impact" — Ops lead.
- Concern: "Zendesk app scope + token rotation / API rate limits". Need Redwood guidance on batching + KV caching to keep rate usage low.
- Security: must support SSO/SAML, SOC2 evidence and KMS integration. Data residency: EU subset for EU customers.

Technical POC details:
- POC scope: classifier for 12 routing tags + free-text short summary model + suggested macro id.
- Success metrics: >=75% precision on top-3 tags, average summary ROUGE-L > baseline, macros suggestions accepted by agents >=40%.
- Integration: Zendesk app prototype that writes tags, adds private note with summary, and shows macro button for A/B.
- Reliability test: synthetic spike generator to 600 reqs/s for 5 minutes to validate autoscale + fallback.

Artifacts: sample extract in Drive, Fireflies call recordings above, security questionnaire in Drive link. Next: Security signoff meeting w/ security team, validate API quota plan, finalize pricing for Dedicated reservation or hosted SLA.
